title: AI-Powered Medical Diagnosis Assistant
description: A clinical decision support system that predicts likely conditions from patient-reported symptoms, vitals and basic lab values. Trains a gradient boosting classifier on an open medical dataset, exposes predictions through a REST API, and shows per-feature contributions so a clinician can see why a prediction was made rather than trusting a black box.

title: Retinal Disease Detection from Fundus Images
description: Detects diabetic retinopathy severity from retinal fundus photographs using a convolutional neural network with transfer learning from a pretrained backbone. Includes class-imbalance handling, aggressive image augmentation, and Grad-CAM heatmaps that highlight the retinal regions driving each prediction.

title: Smart Attendance System Using Face Recognition
description: Marks classroom attendance automatically from a webcam feed. Detects faces, computes embeddings, matches them against enrolled students, and writes attendance records to a database. Handles multiple faces per frame and includes an anti-spoofing check that rejects photographs held up to the camera.

title: Real-Time Object Detection for Traffic Monitoring
description: Counts and classifies vehicles from traffic camera footage using a YOLO family detector with multi-object tracking to avoid double-counting across frames. Produces per-lane vehicle counts, average speed estimates and congestion alerts, rendered on a live dashboard.

title: Sign Language to Text Translator
description: Translates hand-sign gestures into written text in real time. Extracts hand landmarks from webcam frames, feeds landmark sequences into a temporal model to classify signs, and assembles recognised letters into words with a dictionary-based autocorrect pass to smooth misclassifications.

title: Resume Screening and Ranking System
description: Ranks candidate resumes against a job description using semantic similarity rather than keyword counting. Parses PDF and DOCX resumes, extracts skills and experience sections, embeds both resume and job description, and returns a ranked shortlist with the specific matched and missing skills for each candidate.

title: Multilingual Sentiment Analysis for Product Reviews
description: Classifies customer review sentiment across several languages without training a separate model per language, by fine-tuning a multilingual transformer. Includes aspect extraction so a review can be positive about delivery and negative about build quality at the same time, plus a dashboard of sentiment trends over time.

title: Automatic Text Summarisation for News Articles
description: Produces short summaries of long news articles using both an extractive baseline and an abstractive transformer model, letting you compare the two directly. Evaluates output with ROUGE against reference summaries and exposes a web interface where a user pastes an article URL and receives a summary.

title: Fake News Detection Using NLP
description: Classifies news articles as reliable or unreliable by combining linguistic features with a fine-tuned language model. Analyses headline sensationalism, source credibility signals and stance consistency between headline and body, then reports a confidence score with the strongest contributing signals.

title: Conversational FAQ Chatbot with Retrieval
description: Answers questions about an organisation's documentation by retrieving relevant passages and composing a grounded answer, rather than generating from memory. Chunks source documents, embeds them into a vector index, retrieves the best passages per question, and always cites which document the answer came from.

title: Movie Recommendation System with Collaborative Filtering
description: Recommends films by learning latent user and item factors through matrix factorisation, then blends them with a content-based signal derived from genre and plot similarity. Addresses the cold-start problem for new users by falling back to content-based recommendations until enough ratings exist.

title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
description: Flags fraudulent transactions in a heavily imbalanced dataset where genuine fraud is well under one percent of records. Compares resampling strategies and anomaly detection approaches, and tunes the decision threshold explicitly for precision-recall trade-off rather than optimising accuracy, which is misleading here.

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Precision Agriculture
description: Predicts seasonal crop yield from soil composition, rainfall, temperature and historical yield records, helping farmers plan planting decisions. Includes a feature importance analysis showing which environmental factors most affect yield for each crop type, and a simple what-if simulator.

title: Student Performance Prediction and Early Warning
description: Identifies students at risk of failing a course early enough for intervention, using attendance, assignment submission patterns and internal assessment scores. Emphasises fairness analysis, checking that the model does not systematically disadvantage any demographic group before it is deployed.

title: Handwritten Digit and Character Recognition
description: Recognises handwritten digits and letters from scanned images or a drawing canvas, starting from a simple neural network baseline and progressing to a convolutional architecture. A good first deep learning project because the dataset is clean and the accuracy improvement from each change is immediately visible.

title: Music Genre Classification from Audio
description: Classifies songs into genres from raw audio by converting waveforms into mel spectrograms and treating genre recognition as an image classification problem. Compares hand-crafted audio features against learned spectrogram features to show where deep learning helps and where it does not.

title: Image Caption Generator
description: Generates natural language descriptions of photographs by pairing a convolutional image encoder with a sequence decoder that produces text word by word. Includes attention visualisation showing which part of the image the model was looking at as it produced each word of the caption.

title: Stock Price Forecasting with Time Series Models
description: Forecasts short-horizon stock movements using sequence models over historical price and volume data, benchmarked honestly against a naive last-value baseline. Emphasises correct time series validation with walk-forward splits, since random train-test splits leak future information and produce impressive but meaningless accuracy.

title: E-Commerce Platform with Payment Integration
description: A full shopping application covering product catalogue, search and filtering, cart, checkout with a sandbox payment gateway, and order tracking. Includes an admin area for inventory and order management, with role-based access separating customer and administrator capabilities.

title: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor
description: Lets several people edit the same document simultaneously without overwriting each other, using operational transformation or CRDTs to merge concurrent edits. Includes syntax highlighting, cursor presence indicators for each collaborator, and room-based sessions.

title: Personal Finance Tracker with Analytics
description: Tracks income and expenses, categorises transactions automatically from their descriptions, and visualises spending patterns over time. Supports budget limits with alerts, recurring transaction detection, and CSV import from bank statements.

title: Online Learning Management System
description: A course platform where instructors publish lessons, upload video content and set quizzes, and students track their progress through a syllabus. Includes automatic quiz grading, certificate generation on completion, and a discussion thread per lesson.

title: Blog Platform with Markdown and Comments
description: A publishing platform where authors write posts in Markdown with live preview, organise them with tags, and readers comment in threads. Includes full text search across posts, draft and scheduled publishing, and an RSS feed.

title: Smart Home Automation Hub
description: A central controller for home devices that reads sensor data, applies user-defined automation rules, and switches appliances accordingly. Communicates over MQTT, exposes a mobile-friendly control panel, and logs sensor history so a user can see temperature or humidity trends.

title: Air Quality Monitoring Network
description: A distributed network of low-cost sensor nodes reporting particulate matter, temperature and humidity to a central server, which aggregates readings into a live pollution map. Handles intermittent connectivity by buffering readings locally and syncing when the network returns.

title: Smart Irrigation System with Soil Sensors
description: Waters crops only when soil moisture drops below a threshold, factoring in weather forecast data so it does not irrigate right before rainfall. Logs water usage over time to quantify savings against a fixed-schedule baseline, which makes the project's value measurable.

title: Vehicle Tracking and Fleet Management
description: Tracks vehicle location and driving behaviour in real time using GPS modules, presenting live positions on a map alongside route history. Detects harsh braking and speeding events, and generates per-driver safety reports for a fleet operator.

title: Blockchain-Based Electronic Voting System
description: Records votes as blockchain transactions so that results are auditable and tamper-evident, while keeping individual ballots anonymous. Covers voter registration and eligibility verification, one-vote-per-voter enforcement, and a public tally that anyone can independently verify.

title: Supply Chain Provenance Tracker
description: Traces a product from raw material through manufacturing to retail, writing each custody transfer to a blockchain so provenance claims cannot be quietly rewritten. A consumer scans a QR code and sees the full verified journey of the item they are buying.

title: Decentralised Academic Credential Verification
description: Issues tamper-proof digital certificates that employers can verify instantly without contacting the issuing institution. The university signs credentials on-chain, the graduate holds a shareable verification link, and revocation is supported for credentials issued in error.

title: Network Intrusion Detection System
description: Monitors network traffic and flags likely intrusions by combining signature matching for known attacks with anomaly detection for novel ones. Reports alerts with the specific traffic features that triggered them, and includes deliberate tuning work to reduce false positives to a usable level.

title: Phishing URL Detection Using Machine Learning
description: Classifies URLs as phishing or legitimate from lexical and host-based features such as domain age, character distribution, use of URL shorteners and suspicious subdomain patterns. Ships as a browser extension that warns the user before a risky page loads.

title: Secure File Storage with Encryption
description: Stores user files encrypted so that even a compromised server cannot read their contents, using client-side encryption with keys derived from the user's password. Supports secure sharing with specific recipients and includes an integrity check that detects tampering.

title: Password Strength Analyser and Breach Checker
description: Evaluates password strength using entropy estimation and pattern detection rather than naive character-class rules, and checks whether a password has appeared in known breaches using a privacy-preserving k-anonymity lookup that never transmits the full password.

title: Customer Churn Analysis and Retention Dashboard
description: Identifies which customers are likely to cancel a subscription and why, combining a predictive model with cohort analysis. Segments customers by risk level and estimates the revenue impact of retaining each segment, turning a model output into a business decision.

title: COVID-19 Data Analysis and Visualisation Dashboard
description: Aggregates public health time series data into an interactive dashboard showing case trajectories, growth rates and regional comparisons. Handles the messy realities of public data, including reporting delays, revised historical figures and inconsistent regional schemas.

title: Market Basket Analysis for Retail
description: Discovers which products are bought together using association rule mining, then turns those rules into concrete recommendations for store layout and bundle pricing. Distinguishes genuinely interesting rules from trivially obvious ones using lift rather than raw support.

title: Fitness Tracking Mobile Application
description: Logs workouts, tracks progress toward goals and visualises trends over weeks and months. Reads step and heart rate data from device sensors, works offline with later synchronisation, and includes a workout planner that adapts to logged performance.

title: Expense Splitting App for Shared Households
description: Tracks shared expenses among housemates and computes the minimum set of payments needed to settle all debts, rather than naively having everyone pay everyone. Supports uneven splits, recurring bills and settlement history.

title: Offline-First Note Taking App with Sync
description: A note application that works fully offline and reconciles changes when connectivity returns, resolving conflicts when the same note was edited on two devices. Supports rich text, tagging, and full text search over locally stored notes.

title: CI/CD Pipeline with Automated Testing and Deployment
description: Builds a complete delivery pipeline that runs tests, builds container images, and deploys to a cluster on every merge, with automatic rollback when health checks fail after release. Includes environment promotion from staging to production behind a manual approval gate.

title: Serverless Image Processing Pipeline
description: Processes uploaded images without managing servers: an upload triggers a function that generates thumbnails, strips metadata and stores variants in object storage. Demonstrates event-driven architecture, cold-start behaviour and cost characteristics versus an always-on server.

title: Virtual Campus Tour in Augmented Reality
description: Overlays directions, building information and department details onto a phone camera view as a visitor walks around campus. Anchors content to real-world positions, handles GPS drift indoors, and includes an accessible text-only fallback for devices without AR support.

title: VR Chemistry Laboratory Simulator
description: Lets students perform chemistry experiments in virtual reality that would be too dangerous or expensive to run physically. Simulates realistic reactions with correct stoichiometry, enforces safety procedures, and grades the student on their experimental method.

title: Autonomous Line-Following and Obstacle-Avoiding Robot
description: A robot that follows a marked path while detecting and steering around unexpected obstacles, then rejoining its route. Combines infrared line sensors with ultrasonic distance sensing, and implements a PID controller so movement is smooth rather than oscillating.

title: Warehouse Inventory Robot with Path Planning
description: A mobile robot that navigates a warehouse floor to locate and retrieve items, planning efficient routes around static shelving and dynamic obstacles. Implements a grid-based path planning algorithm and re-plans in real time when the environment changes.

title: Voice-Controlled Personal Assistant
description: Responds to spoken commands to set reminders, answer questions, control smart devices and read out summaries. Handles speech recognition, intent classification and slot filling, with a fallback clarification flow when a command is ambiguous rather than guessing wrongly.

title: Plant Disease Identification from Leaf Images
description: Identifies crop diseases from photographs of leaves, giving smallholder farmers a diagnosis without an agronomist visit. Uses transfer learning on a leaf image dataset, works on low-end phones through model quantisation, and suggests treatment steps for each identified disease.

title: Energy Consumption Forecasting for Smart Grids
description: Forecasts household and district electricity demand to help balance grid load, using historical consumption alongside weather and calendar features. Quantifies forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals, which matters more than a point estimate for grid operators planning capacity.

title: Accessibility Checker for Web Pages
description: Audits a web page against accessibility guidelines and reports concrete violations with the offending element and a suggested fix. Checks colour contrast, missing alternative text, heading structure, keyboard navigability and ARIA misuse, then produces a prioritised remediation report.

title: Loan Default Risk Scoring with Explainable Features
description: Scores loan applications for default risk using a gradient boosting model trained on historical repayment records. Handles the heavy class imbalance with cost-sensitive learning rather than naive oversampling, and reports per-application feature contributions so a loan officer can justify a rejection to the applicant.

title: Employee Attrition Prediction from HR Records
description: Predicts which employees are most likely to resign within the next year from tenure, compensation, promotion history and satisfaction survey scores. Surfaces the strongest drivers per department so HR can act on causes rather than symptoms, and flags where the data is too sparse to support a confident prediction.

title: Insurance Claim Fraud Detection
description: Flags suspicious insurance claims by combining supervised classification on labelled fraud cases with unsupervised anomaly scores for patterns never seen before. Optimises for precision at a fixed investigator capacity, because a fraud team can only review a fixed number of cases per week.

title: House Price Estimation with Geospatial Features
description: Estimates residential property prices from size, age and condition plus derived geospatial features such as distance to transport, schools and commercial centres. Compares tree ensembles against linear baselines and shows where the model systematically under-prices particular neighbourhoods.

title: Customer Lifetime Value Prediction
description: Predicts how much revenue each customer will generate over the next two years by modelling purchase frequency and average order value separately. Segments customers into value tiers so a marketing budget can be allocated where incremental spend actually pays back.

title: Demand Forecasting for Retail Inventory
description: Forecasts weekly unit demand per product per store, reconciling store-level forecasts so they sum correctly to regional and national totals. Reports stockout and overstock cost rather than raw error, since a forecast that is wrong in the expensive direction matters more than one that is merely wrong.

title: Telecom Churn Prediction with Cost-Sensitive Learning
description: Identifies subscribers likely to leave in the next billing cycle and ranks them by expected revenue at risk rather than churn probability alone. Calibrates predicted probabilities so the retention team can set a defensible discount threshold instead of guessing.

title: Credit Scoring for Thin-File Applicants
description: Builds a credit score for applicants with little or no formal borrowing history using alternative signals such as utility and rent payment regularity. Audits the resulting model for disparate impact across demographic groups, because an accurate scorecard that quietly excludes a protected group is not deployable.

title: Predictive Maintenance for Industrial Machines
description: Predicts remaining useful life of rotating machinery from vibration, temperature and current sensor streams. Frames the problem as time-to-failure rather than binary classification, so maintenance can be scheduled at the right moment rather than merely warned about.

title: Flight Delay Prediction from Weather and Schedule Data
description: Predicts whether a scheduled flight will be delayed more than fifteen minutes by joining airline schedule data with historical weather at both origin and destination. Separates delays the airline controls from those it does not, so the model explains rather than merely predicts.

title: Taxi Fare and Trip Duration Estimation
description: Estimates both fare and journey time for a taxi trip from pickup and drop-off coordinates, time of day and passenger count. Demonstrates why raw straight-line distance underestimates urban trips and how time-of-day features recover most of the lost accuracy.

title: Sports Match Outcome Prediction
description: Predicts win, draw or loss for league fixtures using team strength ratings updated match by match alongside recent form and home advantage. Backtests against a full season and compares calibrated probabilities with bookmaker odds to show where the model has genuine edge.

title: Wine Quality Assessment from Physicochemical Tests
description: Predicts expert quality ratings for wine from measurable physicochemical properties such as acidity, sugar and sulphate levels. A compact first classification project that shows how ordinal targets behave differently from unordered categories.

title: Bank Marketing Campaign Response Prediction
description: Predicts which customers will subscribe to a term deposit after a telemarketing call, so the call list can be ranked rather than dialled at random. Reports lift at each decile to show how much calling effort the model saves.

title: Diabetes Onset Risk Prediction
description: Estimates the risk of diabetes onset from routine clinical measurements such as glucose, BMI, age and blood pressure. Treats physiologically impossible zero values as missing rather than real, a data quality trap this dataset is well known for.

title: Heart Disease Risk Stratification
description: Stratifies patients into low, moderate and high cardiac risk bands from clinical history and test results. Emphasises calibrated probabilities over raw accuracy, because a triage band is only useful if the stated risk matches observed outcomes.

title: Breast Cancer Diagnosis from Cell Nuclei Measurements
description: Classifies tumours as benign or malignant from digitised measurements of cell nuclei in fine needle aspirate images. Optimises explicitly for recall, since a missed malignancy costs far more than a false alarm that leads to one extra test.

title: Loan Approval Fairness Audit
description: Audits an existing loan approval model for disparate impact across gender, age and region, then compares three mitigation strategies. Shows the accuracy cost of each fix explicitly, because pretending fairness is free is what makes these audits get ignored.

title: E-Commerce Product Return Prediction
description: Predicts at checkout whether an order will be returned, using product category, price, customer history and size selection behaviour. Converts predictions into expected reverse-logistics cost so the business can decide which returns are worth preventing.

title: Hotel Booking Cancellation Forecasting
description: Predicts which confirmed hotel bookings will be cancelled, so overbooking limits can be set from data rather than habit. Shows how lead time and deposit type dominate the prediction, and how that changes by season.

title: Energy Theft Detection in Smart Meters
description: Detects likely electricity theft from smart meter consumption patterns by learning each household's normal profile and flagging sustained deviations. Ranks cases by confidence and expected recovered revenue, because field inspection capacity is the real constraint.

title: Soil Fertility Classification for Fertiliser Advice
description: Classifies soil samples into fertility categories from nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and pH readings, then maps each class to a concrete fertiliser recommendation. Written for use by an agricultural extension worker rather than a data scientist.

title: Water Potability Classification
description: Predicts whether a water sample is safe to drink from measurements such as pH, hardness, solids and chloramine level. Deliberately explores why a naively accurate model can still be useless when the cost of a false negative is a public health incident.

title: Air Ticket Price Trend Predictor
description: Predicts how an air ticket price will move over the days remaining before departure, advising a traveller whether to buy now or wait. Models price as a trajectory rather than a single number, since the useful output is a decision not an estimate.

title: Restaurant Rating Prediction from Attributes
description: Predicts a restaurant's average customer rating from cuisine, price band, location and service attributes. Examines how much of the rating is explained by attributes at all, and what that ceiling implies about review-based recommendation.

title: Used Car Price Valuation
description: Values a used car from make, model, age, mileage, fuel type and ownership count, exposed as a simple form a seller can use. Shows how depreciation is non-linear in age and why a naive linear model over-values old vehicles.

title: Crop Recommendation from Soil and Climate
description: Recommends the most suitable crop to plant given soil nutrient levels, rainfall, temperature and humidity for a location. Returns a ranked shortlist with confidence rather than a single answer, so a farmer can weigh the suggestion against market prices.

title: Student Dropout Early Warning with Interpretability
description: Flags students at risk of dropping out early enough for intervention, using attendance, assessment and engagement data. Checks that the model is not simply rediscovering socioeconomic status, and reports which factors are actually actionable by the institution.

title: Music Popularity Prediction from Audio Features
description: Predicts how popular a track will become from extracted audio characteristics such as tempo, energy, danceability and loudness. Investigates how much popularity is musical at all versus driven by artist reach, and reports that honestly.

title: Movie Box Office Revenue Forecasting
description: Forecasts opening weekend and total revenue for a film from budget, genre, cast prominence, release timing and screen count. Works in log space because box office revenue spans four orders of magnitude and raw-scale errors are dominated by blockbusters.

title: Rainfall Prediction for Agricultural Planning
description: Predicts next-day rainfall from historical meteorological observations for use in irrigation and sowing decisions. Evaluates against a persistence baseline, since predicting tomorrow will resemble today is a surprisingly strong forecaster.

title: Traffic Volume Forecasting
description: Forecasts hourly vehicle counts on a road segment using seasonality, weather and public holiday effects. Separates recurring congestion from incident-driven spikes, because only the first is predictable and the two need different responses.

title: Electricity Load Forecasting for Households
description: Forecasts household electricity demand at half-hourly resolution using lagged consumption, temperature and calendar features. Compares classical regression against gradient boosting and shows where each fails during unusual weather.

title: Employee Salary Estimation from Job Postings
description: Estimates a fair salary range for a job posting from its title, required skills, seniority wording and location. Extracts structured signals from free text job descriptions, which is where most of the predictive information actually sits.

title: Anomaly Detection in Server Metrics
description: Detects abnormal behaviour in CPU, memory, latency and error-rate metrics without labelled incident data. Tunes explicitly for alert fatigue, since a detector that fires ten times a night gets muted and then provides no value at all.

title: Insurance Premium Pricing Model
description: Prices motor insurance premiums from driver, vehicle and claims history data using a frequency-severity decomposition. Constrains the model against prohibited rating factors and quantifies the premium impact of each constraint.

title: Store Sales Prediction with Promotions
description: Predicts daily sales per store while separating baseline demand from promotional uplift, so marketing can measure what a discount actually bought. Uses time-based validation splits, because random splits leak future information in any sales series.

title: Product Recommendation with Matrix Factorisation
description: Recommends products from implicit purchase history using matrix factorisation, with a content-based fallback for new users and new items. Demonstrates why accuracy alone is a poor objective when every recommendation is a bestseller nobody needed help finding.

title: Fake Review Detection with Behavioural Features
description: Detects fraudulent product reviews by combining writing style signals with reviewer behaviour such as posting bursts, rating extremity and account age. Shows that behavioural features carry more signal than text alone, which is the opposite of the usual assumption.

title: Bike Sharing Demand Prediction
description: Predicts hourly bike rental counts from weather, season and calendar data for rebalancing planning. Demonstrates cyclical encoding of hour and month, without which a model treats 23:00 and 00:00 as maximally distant.

title: Automated Essay Scoring with Rubric Alignment
description: Scores student essays against a marking rubric and reports a sub-score per rubric dimension rather than one opaque number. Measures agreement with human markers using quadratic weighted kappa, and checks that scores do not simply track essay length.

title: Chess Engine with Minimax and Alpha-Beta Pruning
description: Plays chess using minimax search with alpha-beta pruning, iterative deepening and a hand-built position evaluation function. Measures how many positions pruning removes at each depth, which is the clearest demonstration of why the optimisation matters.

title: Sudoku Solver with Constraint Propagation
description: Solves Sudoku puzzles by combining constraint propagation with backtracking search, and can also generate puzzles of a target difficulty. Compares raw backtracking against constraint-first solving to show the enormous difference in search effort.

title: Pathfinding Visualiser for A-star and Dijkstra
description: Animates how A-star, Dijkstra and breadth-first search explore a grid with obstacles, drawn cell by cell as each algorithm runs. Makes the role of the heuristic visible by letting the user switch heuristics and watch the explored region shrink.

title: Reinforcement Learning Agent for Grid World
description: Trains an agent to navigate a grid world with rewards and hazards using tabular Q-learning and SARSA. Plots the learned value function as a heatmap so the difference between on-policy and off-policy learning becomes visible rather than theoretical.

title: Game Playing Agent for Connect Four
description: Plays Connect Four with a configurable-depth minimax agent and a positional evaluation function. Includes difficulty levels implemented by limiting search depth and adding controlled randomness, rather than by deliberately playing badly.

title: Expert System for Plant Disease Advisory
description: Diagnoses crop problems from farmer-answered symptom questions using a forward-chaining rule engine with an explicit knowledge base. Explains which rules fired and why, so the advice can be checked by an agronomist instead of trusted blindly.

title: Automated Timetable Scheduling with Genetic Algorithms
description: Generates conflict-free university timetables respecting room capacity, lecturer availability and student course combinations. Encodes hard constraints as infeasibility and soft preferences as fitness penalties, so the search never trades a valid schedule for a merely pleasant one.

title: Vehicle Routing Optimiser for Delivery Fleets
description: Plans delivery routes for a vehicle fleet under capacity and time-window constraints using construction heuristics refined by local search. Compares solution quality and runtime against a naive nearest-neighbour route to quantify what the optimisation is worth.

title: Knowledge Graph Question Answering
description: Answers natural language questions by translating them into graph queries over an entity-relationship knowledge base. Handles multi-hop questions that require chaining relations, which is precisely where keyword search fails and a graph earns its place.

title: AI Tutor with Adaptive Question Difficulty
description: Selects the next practice question for a learner based on an estimate of their current ability, targeting the difficulty where information gain is highest. Uses item response theory so the estimate improves with far fewer questions than a fixed quiz.

title: Resume-to-Job Matching with Explainable Scores
description: Matches candidate resumes to job openings on meaning rather than keyword overlap, and reports which specific skills drove each match. Names the missing requirements too, so a rejected candidate learns something actionable.

title: Automated Meeting Minutes Generator
description: Transcribes a recorded meeting, attributes speech to speakers, and produces structured minutes with decisions and action items separated from discussion. Extracts action items as who-owes-what rather than burying them in prose.

title: Multi-Agent Traffic Signal Coordination
description: Trains reinforcement learning agents to control traffic lights at neighbouring junctions so their timings coordinate rather than compete. Evaluates against fixed-time and actuated baselines on total network delay, the metric traffic engineers actually care about.

title: AI Dungeon Master for Text Adventures
description: Runs an interactive text adventure where a language model narrates outcomes while an explicit state machine tracks inventory, health and world facts. Keeping state outside the model is what stops the story quietly contradicting itself after twenty turns.

title: Portfolio Rebalancing Agent with Risk Constraints
description: Recommends portfolio rebalancing trades that maximise expected return subject to volatility, sector exposure and turnover limits. Backtests across multiple market regimes, since a strategy tuned on a single bull run tells you nothing.

title: Automated Curriculum Planner for Degree Programmes
description: Builds a valid semester-by-semester study plan from course prerequisites, credit limits and offering schedules. Models prerequisites as a directed graph and detects impossible requirements such as cycles before a student discovers them in their final year.

title: Medical Triage Assistant with Symptom Ranking
description: Ranks likely conditions from reported symptoms and assigns an urgency band, designed explicitly to over-refer rather than under-refer. Presents differentials with reasoning and refuses to answer where the symptom set is too thin to support any ranking.

title: Legal Document Clause Extractor
description: Extracts obligations, termination conditions, payment terms and liability caps from contracts and presents them as a structured summary. Reports a confidence per extracted clause and links back to the source paragraph so a lawyer can verify rather than trust.

title: AI Referee for Debate Argument Quality
description: Scores debate contributions on evidence use, relevance and logical structure, flagging common fallacies with the span that triggered them. Deliberately reports low confidence on rhetorical passages, where automated argument quality judgement is genuinely unreliable.

title: Smart Parking Allocation Optimiser
description: Allocates arriving vehicles to parking bays to minimise total walking distance and internal congestion, updating as spaces free up. Simulates a full day of arrivals to show the improvement over first-come-first-served allocation.

title: Automated Crop Rotation Planner
description: Plans a multi-season crop rotation that respects nutrient depletion, pest cycles and market demand for a given plot. Treats soil nitrogen as a state carried between seasons, which is what makes rotation planning more than repeated single-season choice.

title: Conversational Banking Assistant with Intent Routing
description: Handles common banking requests such as balance checks and card blocking by classifying intent and routing to the right handler. Escalates to a human on low confidence rather than guessing, because a confidently wrong answer about money is worse than no answer.

title: AI Code Review Assistant for Style Violations
description: Reviews a pull request diff and comments on naming, complexity, duplication and missing error handling. Comments only on changed lines, since a tool that reports two hundred pre-existing issues on every pull request gets switched off immediately.

title: Automated Radiology Report Structuring
description: Converts free-text radiology reports into structured findings with anatomical site, observation and certainty. Handles negation and hedging explicitly, because no evidence of fracture and fracture differ by one word and completely reverse the meaning.

title: Warehouse Slotting Optimiser
description: Assigns products to warehouse locations so that frequently picked and frequently co-picked items sit near the dispatch area and near each other. Simulates picker travel distance before and after to quantify the saving in walking kilometres per shift.

title: Personalised Diet Planner with Nutrient Constraints
description: Builds a weekly meal plan meeting calorie and macronutrient targets while respecting allergies, budget and cuisine preference. Solves it as a constrained optimisation, then adds variety penalties so the mathematically optimal plan is not the same meal fourteen times.

title: AI Opponent for Tic-Tac-Toe with Difficulty Levels
description: Implements a Tic-Tac-Toe opponent whose difficulty ranges from random play to a perfect minimax player that can never be beaten. A compact first AI project where the whole game tree is small enough to explore and reason about completely.

title: Emergency Response Resource Allocator
description: Assigns ambulances and fire units to incidents by urgency, travel time and unit capability, re-planning as new calls arrive. Simulates a busy shift to compare against nearest-available dispatch, which is optimal per call and poor across the whole shift.

title: Automated Grading of Programming Assignments
description: Runs student code against hidden test cases inside a sandboxed container and produces a mark with targeted feedback. Includes structural similarity checks across submissions, and reports partial credit per test rather than a single pass or fail.

title: Pneumonia Detection from Chest X-Rays
description: Classifies chest radiographs as normal or pneumonia using transfer learning from a pretrained convolutional backbone. Reports sensitivity separately from accuracy and overlays activation maps so a clinician can see which lung region drove the prediction.

title: Skin Lesion Classification with Transfer Learning
description: Classifies dermoscopic images into lesion categories including melanoma using a fine-tuned convolutional network. Evaluates accuracy separately across skin tones, because dermatology datasets are heavily skewed toward lighter skin and aggregate accuracy hides that failure.

title: Brain Tumour Segmentation from MRI
description: Segments tumour regions in multi-modal brain MRI volumes with a U-Net style encoder-decoder. Scores with Dice overlap rather than pixel accuracy, since a model that predicts all background scores extremely well on the latter and is useless.

title: Speech Emotion Recognition from Audio
description: Recognises emotional state from short speech clips by converting audio to mel spectrograms and classifying them with a convolutional network. Tests generalisation across speakers, where models that memorise voices rather than emotions collapse.

title: Environmental Sound Classification
description: Identifies everyday sounds such as sirens, drilling and dog barks from short recordings for urban noise monitoring. Uses time and frequency masking augmentation, which matters more than architecture choice on small audio datasets.

title: Neural Style Transfer for Artwork
description: Recomposes a photograph in the visual style of a chosen painting by optimising an image against separate content and style losses. Exposes the style-content weighting so the user can see the trade-off rather than accept one fixed aesthetic.

title: Image Super-Resolution with Deep Networks
description: Upscales low-resolution images while recovering plausible detail, comparing pixel-wise and perceptual training objectives. Shows why the network with the best signal-to-noise ratio often produces the blurrier and less convincing picture.

title: Image Denoising with Convolutional Autoencoders
description: Removes sensor noise from photographs using a convolutional autoencoder trained on synthetically corrupted pairs. Compares against classical filtering to show where learned denoising wins and where it invents detail that was never there.

title: Handwriting Generation with Recurrent Networks
description: Generates realistic handwritten text as pen stroke sequences rather than pixels, conditioned on a target string. Models pen position as a mixture density output, which is what allows natural variation instead of one rigid average stroke.

title: Text-to-Speech Synthesis
description: Converts written text into natural-sounding speech using a sequence-to-sequence acoustic model followed by a neural vocoder. Evaluates with listening tests alongside spectral distance, because low spectral error still permits robotic-sounding output.

title: Anomaly Detection in Time Series with Autoencoders
description: Detects abnormal machine behaviour by training a sequence autoencoder on normal operation only and flagging poor reconstructions. Selects thresholds from a validation period rather than the training data, which otherwise guarantees an over-optimistic false alarm rate.

title: Human Activity Recognition from Accelerometer Data
description: Recognises walking, sitting, climbing stairs and running from smartphone accelerometer and gyroscope streams. Uses subject-wise splits so the reported accuracy reflects new users rather than memorised gait signatures.

title: ECG Arrhythmia Classification
description: Classifies individual heartbeats from ECG recordings into normal and several arrhythmia types. Segments beats around detected R-peaks first, since fixed-length windowing misaligns beats and destroys most of the morphological signal.

title: EEG Signal Classification for Brain-Computer Interface
description: Classifies motor imagery from EEG recordings to drive a simple brain-computer interface. Applies spatial filtering before the network and reports cross-subject accuracy, which is dramatically lower than within-subject and far more honest.

title: Facial Expression Recognition
description: Recognises seven basic facial expressions from webcam frames after detecting and aligning the face. Aligning on eye landmarks before classification removes head pose as a confound and measurably improves accuracy.

title: Age and Gender Estimation from Face Images
description: Predicts approximate age and gender from a face photograph using a shared backbone with two output heads. Reports error by demographic subgroup and discusses the ethical limits of deploying such a model at all.

title: Deepfake Detection in Video
description: Detects manipulated faces in video by combining per-frame artefact detection with temporal consistency checks. Tests against generation methods absent from training, where most published detectors lose the majority of their accuracy.

title: Video Action Recognition
description: Classifies short video clips into human actions using sampled frames and a temporal aggregation network. Compares single-frame against temporal models to quantify how much of the label is guessable from one frame alone.

title: Optical Character Recognition for Handwritten Forms
description: Reads handwritten entries from scanned forms by detecting field regions then recognising the text inside each. Applies field-specific validation such as date and numeric constraints, which corrects a large share of raw recognition errors.

title: Music Generation with Recurrent Networks
description: Generates short musical passages as symbolic note sequences conditioned on a chosen key and style. Represents music as events with duration rather than fixed time steps, which produces far more natural rhythm.

title: Protein Secondary Structure Prediction
description: Predicts helix, sheet and coil structure for each residue in a protein sequence using a bidirectional sequence model. Uses evolutionary profile features alongside raw sequence, which historically provided the largest single accuracy jump in this task.

title: Molecular Property Prediction with Graph Networks
description: Predicts solubility and toxicity of molecules represented as atom-bond graphs using a graph neural network. Splits by molecular scaffold rather than randomly, since random splits let near-identical molecules appear in both train and test.

title: Satellite Image Land Cover Classification
description: Classifies satellite image tiles into land cover types such as forest, water, cropland and urban. Uses multispectral bands beyond visible light, which separate vegetation types that look identical in an RGB rendering.

title: Weather Nowcasting from Radar Sequences
description: Predicts rainfall intensity over the next two hours from a sequence of weather radar frames. Treats the problem as video prediction, and evaluates on rain-event thresholds rather than average error which is dominated by dry pixels.

title: Lip Reading from Video
description: Recognises spoken words from silent video by tracking the mouth region and decoding the visual sequence. Reports accuracy on unseen speakers, since lip appearance varies enormously between people and inflates same-speaker scores.

title: Image Colourisation of Grayscale Photos
description: Adds plausible colour to black and white photographs using an encoder-decoder trained on desaturated pairs. Predicts in a perceptual colour space and treats colour as a classification over bins, which avoids the desaturated brown average that regression produces.

title: Semantic Segmentation of Urban Street Scenes
description: Labels every pixel of a street scene as road, pedestrian, vehicle, building or vegetation for autonomous driving perception. Weights rare but safety-critical classes such as pedestrians so they are not sacrificed to improve overall pixel accuracy.

title: Pose Estimation for Fitness Form Correction
description: Tracks body keypoints during exercises and gives live feedback on joint angles for squats, push-ups and lunges. Counts repetitions from the angle trajectory rather than time, so slow and fast reps both register correctly.

title: Crowd Counting from Surveillance Images
description: Estimates crowd size from surveillance images by predicting a density map and integrating it, rather than detecting individuals. Detection fails badly in dense crowds where people overlap, which is exactly where the count matters most.

title: Fashion Item Recommendation from Images
description: Recommends visually similar clothing items by embedding product photographs and searching the catalogue by nearest neighbour. Separates style similarity from colour similarity, so a user looking for a cut is not shown the same colour in every category.

title: Audio Source Separation
description: Separates a mixed recording into vocal and instrumental stems by predicting time-frequency masks. Evaluates with signal-to-distortion ratio and by listening, since masking artefacts are audible long before they show up numerically.

title: Speaker Identification from Voice
description: Identifies who is speaking from a short utterance by learning speaker embeddings and comparing them by distance. Evaluates with equal error rate on unseen speakers, the standard for verification systems and far stricter than closed-set accuracy.

title: Chest CT Nodule Detection
description: Detects pulmonary nodules in chest CT volumes with a two-stage pipeline that proposes candidates then filters false positives. Reports sensitivity at fixed false positives per scan, the metric radiology screening studies actually use.

title: Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
description: Converts a photograph of a handwritten equation into structured markup, recovering superscripts, fractions and nested groupings. Spatial structure rather than symbol identity is the hard part, since the same symbols mean different things by position.

title: Time Series Forecasting with Temporal Convolutional Networks
description: Forecasts multivariate time series using dilated causal convolutions instead of recurrence, and benchmarks against recurrent baselines. Shows how receptive field size, not depth alone, determines how far back the model can actually see.

title: Automatic Number Plate Recognition
description: Detects vehicle number plates in camera images and reads the characters into text for gate access or toll logging. Rectifies plate perspective before recognition, without which angled captures lose most of their character accuracy.

title: Helmet Detection for Two-Wheeler Safety
description: Detects riders without helmets in traffic camera footage and captures the associated number plate for enforcement. Links rider and motorcycle detections so a pillion passenger is not mistakenly attributed to a different vehicle.

title: Fire and Smoke Detection from Camera Feeds
description: Detects fire and smoke in surveillance video and raises an alarm with the frame that triggered it. Requires persistence across consecutive frames before alerting, because single-frame detectors fire constantly on sunsets and headlights.

title: Pothole Detection from Dashcam Video
description: Detects potholes in dashcam footage and tags each with GPS coordinates to build a road condition map. Deduplicates repeat sightings of the same pothole across frames and journeys, which otherwise inflates counts enormously.

title: Parking Space Occupancy Detection
description: Determines which marked parking bays are occupied from a fixed overhead camera, updating a live availability map. Uses predefined bay regions rather than general object detection, which is both far cheaper and more reliable for a static camera.

title: Barcode and QR Code Scanner with Inventory Lookup
description: Scans barcodes and QR codes from a camera stream and looks each up against a product database to show stock and price. Handles poor lighting and partial occlusion, which is what separates a demo from something usable at a counter.

title: Document Scanner with Perspective Correction
description: Turns a photograph of a page into a clean flat scan by detecting the document edges and correcting perspective. Applies adaptive thresholding afterwards so shadows across the page do not become grey bands in the output.

title: Table Extraction from Scanned Documents
description: Extracts tabular data from scanned reports into structured rows and columns, handling merged cells and missing rulings. Reconstructs borderless tables from text alignment, which is where most naive line-detection approaches fail completely.

title: Signature Verification System
description: Verifies whether a signature matches a reference by learning an embedding where genuine pairs sit close together. Trains against skilled forgeries specifically, since random-forgery training produces a model that any deliberate imitation defeats.

title: Currency Note Recognition for Visually Impaired
description: Identifies banknote denominations from a phone camera and announces the value aloud for visually impaired users. Designed around audio-first interaction and tolerant of poor framing, since the user cannot see how the note is positioned.

title: Product Defect Detection on Assembly Line
description: Detects manufacturing defects from line-scan camera images using anomaly detection trained only on defect-free examples. Learning normality rather than defect classes is what makes the system work on defect types nobody has seen yet.

title: Fruit Ripeness Grading from Images
description: Grades fruit ripeness from photographs into unripe, ripe and overripe categories for sorting and pricing. Compares a colour-histogram baseline against a small convolutional network to show when deep learning is genuinely necessary.

title: Livestock Counting from Aerial Images
description: Counts cattle and sheep in drone imagery of open pasture using tiled detection over high-resolution frames. Merges detections across tile boundaries, which is the main source of double counting in aerial pipelines.

title: Weed Detection for Precision Spraying
description: Distinguishes weeds from crop seedlings in real time so a sprayer treats only the weeds. Runs on an edge device in the field, where inference latency directly sets the maximum safe tractor speed.

title: Fish Species Identification from Underwater Images
description: Identifies fish species from underwater camera footage for ecological surveys. Corrects the blue-green colour cast of underwater imagery first, and handles a long-tailed species distribution where most classes have very few examples.

title: Wildlife Camera Trap Species Classifier
description: Classifies animal species in camera trap photographs and discards the large majority of frames triggered by moving vegetation. Filtering empty frames first is what makes the workload tractable for ecologists reviewing millions of images.

title: Solar Panel Fault Detection from Thermal Images
description: Finds hotspots and faulty cells in solar farms from drone-captured thermal imagery. Segments individual panels first so a fault is reported against a specific serial-numbered unit rather than a coordinate on a photo.

title: Crack Detection in Concrete Structures
description: Detects and measures cracks in concrete from inspection photographs, reporting width and length in millimetres. Requires a scale reference in frame, without which pixel measurements are meaningless for structural assessment.

title: Road Lane Detection for Driver Assistance
description: Detects lane boundaries in dashcam video and warns on unintended departure, using a bird's-eye perspective transform. Fits curves rather than straight lines so the system holds through bends where straight-line detection breaks.

title: Driver Drowsiness Detection
description: Detects driver fatigue from webcam video by tracking eye closure duration and yawning frequency. Uses sustained closure over consecutive frames rather than a single blink, which is the difference between a useful alarm and constant noise.

title: Gesture-Controlled Media Player
description: Controls playback, volume and track selection with hand gestures detected from a webcam. Requires a gesture to be held briefly before firing, which prevents ordinary hand movement from constantly triggering commands.

title: Virtual Try-On for Eyewear
description: Overlays spectacle frames onto a live camera view of the user's face, scaled and rotated to fit. Estimates real-world face width to size frames correctly, so the preview reflects how the glasses would actually look.

title: Sports Player Tracking and Heatmaps
description: Tracks players through match footage and projects positions onto a pitch diagram to produce movement heatmaps. Maintains player identity through occlusions and jersey similarity, which is the genuinely hard part of sports tracking.

title: Ball Trajectory Tracking in Cricket
description: Tracks the cricket ball through delivery footage and reconstructs its trajectory including bounce point. Fits a physical motion model so the path stays plausible through frames where the fast-moving ball is blurred or missing.

title: Queue Length Estimation in Retail Stores
description: Estimates checkout queue length and waiting time from ceiling camera footage to trigger staffing decisions. Counts people inside defined queue zones rather than the whole frame, so passers-by are not added to the queue.

title: Shelf Stock Monitoring for Retail
description: Detects empty shelf space and misplaced products by comparing shelf images against the intended planogram. Reports gaps by product slot rather than pixel region, so the alert tells staff exactly what to restock.

title: Waste Segregation by Image Classification
description: Classifies waste items into recyclable categories such as plastic, paper, metal and organic from a photograph. Reports low confidence rather than guessing on ambiguous items like coated paper cups, which are the ones people actually get wrong.

title: Blood Cell Counting from Microscope Images
description: Counts and classifies red cells, white cells and platelets in microscope images of blood smears. Separates touching cells with watershed segmentation, which is the dominant source of counting error in dense smears.

title: Malaria Parasite Detection in Blood Smears
description: Detects malaria parasites inside red blood cells from stained smear images for low-resource screening. Optimises for sensitivity and reports per-cell rather than per-image results, so parasite density can be estimated for treatment decisions.

title: Dental Caries Detection from X-Rays
description: Detects tooth decay in dental radiographs and marks the affected tooth position. Uses tooth numbering as structured output so findings integrate with dental records instead of being loose bounding boxes.

title: Bone Fracture Detection from Radiographs
description: Detects and localises bone fractures in limb radiographs, highlighting the suspected region for a clinician. Reports sensitivity by fracture type, since hairline fractures are both the hardest to detect and the most commonly missed clinically.

title: People Counting for Footfall Analytics
description: Counts people entering and leaving a venue by tracking detections across a virtual line in the camera view. Requires direction of crossing so someone loitering at the doorway is not counted repeatedly.

title: Book Spine Recognition for Library Shelving
description: Reads book spine titles from a shelf photograph to detect misplaced volumes against the catalogue order. Handles vertical and rotated text, which standard OCR pipelines skip entirely by default.

title: Handwritten Answer Sheet Evaluation
description: Reads handwritten short answers from scanned exam sheets and scores them against a marking scheme. Routes low-confidence recognitions to human review rather than guessing, because a misread answer becomes an unfair mark.

title: Image Forgery Detection
description: Detects copy-move and splicing manipulation in photographs using compression artefact and noise inconsistency analysis. Localises the tampered region rather than only classifying the image, which is what an investigator actually needs.

title: Panorama Stitching from Multiple Photos
description: Stitches overlapping photographs into a single panorama by matching features and estimating homographies. Blends seams by exposure compensation, without which the joins are visible as obvious brightness steps.

title: Depth Estimation from a Single Image
description: Predicts a per-pixel depth map from one ordinary photograph using an encoder-decoder network. Addresses scale ambiguity explicitly, since a single image cannot determine absolute distance without an external reference.

title: Visual Product Search by Photo
description: Finds catalogue products matching a user-uploaded photograph using image embeddings and approximate nearest neighbour search. Indexes multiple crops per product so a search on a photographed detail still retrieves the right item.

title: Named Entity Recognition for Medical Text
description: Extracts drugs, dosages, conditions and procedures from clinical narratives as typed entities. Adapts a general-purpose model to medical language, where ordinary tokenisers split dosage strings and drug names in ways that destroy the entity.

title: Toxic Comment Classification for Moderation
description: Flags toxic, threatening and identity-attacking comments as independent labels rather than one score. Audits for false positives on reclaimed slurs and dialect, where naive moderation models penalise the communities they are meant to protect.

title: Language Identification for Short Texts
description: Identifies which of fifty languages a short piece of text is written in using character n-gram features. Demonstrates why short strings are far harder than documents, and reports accuracy bucketed by input length.

title: Machine Translation for Low-Resource Language Pairs
description: Translates between a high-resource and a low-resource language by fine-tuning a multilingual pretrained model. Uses back-translation to synthesise additional training pairs, which is the standard remedy when parallel data runs out.

title: Grammar and Style Correction Assistant
description: Suggests grammar and style corrections with an explanation of the rule behind each edit. Distinguishes genuine errors from stylistic preference and labels them differently, so a writer can accept one and ignore the other.

title: Question Generation from Textbook Passages
description: Generates comprehension questions with answers from textbook paragraphs to build practice quizzes. Filters generated questions whose answers cannot be located in the source, which removes the majority of unusable output.

title: Semantic Search over Research Papers
description: Searches a corpus of research abstracts by meaning, so a query about crop disease finds relevant work sharing no keywords. Chunks long documents with overlap, since embedding an entire paper into one vector loses everything but the dominant topic.

title: Topic Modelling of Customer Support Tickets
description: Discovers recurring themes in support tickets without predefined categories, and tracks how each theme's volume moves over time. Labels topics from representative documents rather than top words alone, which are frequently uninterpretable on their own.

title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis for Hotels
description: Separates sentiment per aspect within a single review, so praise for the location and complaints about the noise are scored independently. A single overall polarity averages these into a rating that describes neither.

title: Sarcasm Detection in Social Media Posts
description: Detects sarcastic intent in posts where literal sentiment inverts the actual meaning. Uses conversational context where available, because sarcasm is frequently undetectable from the sentence alone even for human readers.

title: Emotion Detection in Text Messages
description: Classifies short messages into emotions such as joy, anger, sadness and fear. Treats emoji as first-class signal rather than stripping them, since in short informal text they often carry the entire emotional load.

title: Keyword and Keyphrase Extraction
description: Extracts the most representative keyphrases from a document using statistical scoring combined with grammatical filtering. Compares frequency-based and graph-based ranking to show how each fails on different document lengths.

title: Text Plagiarism Detection by Meaning
description: Detects plagiarism that survives paraphrasing by comparing passages on meaning rather than shared wording. Reports the matching source passages side by side, since a similarity number alone cannot be acted on by a marker.

title: Spam SMS Classification
description: Classifies text messages as spam or legitimate using bag-of-words features and a Naive Bayes classifier. A compact first NLP project that shows why precision matters more than recall when the cost is a blocked real message.

title: Email Intent Classification and Routing
description: Classifies incoming email by intent and routes it to the correct team automatically. Routes low-confidence messages to a general queue rather than guessing, because a misrouted complaint costs more than an unrouted one.

title: Job Description Skill Extraction
description: Extracts required skills from job postings and normalises variants onto a single taxonomy entry. Mapping the many surface forms of one skill together is what makes downstream demand analysis meaningful.

title: Automatic Subtitle Generation and Alignment
description: Generates timed subtitles from video audio, splitting text into readable caption lines at natural pauses. Enforces reading-speed limits so captions stay on screen long enough to actually be read.

title: Cross-Lingual Document Retrieval
description: Retrieves documents in one language using queries written in another, via a shared multilingual embedding space. Evaluates whether retrieval quality is symmetric across language directions, which it usually is not.

title: Text Readability Scoring
description: Scores how difficult a passage is to read using classical readability formulas alongside learned features. Shows where formula-based scores disagree with human judgement, typically on technical text with short sentences.

title: Coreference Resolution for Narrative Text
description: Links pronouns and noun phrases to the entities they refer to across a narrative. Resolving who "she" refers to three paragraphs later is what makes downstream summarisation and question answering coherent.

title: Abstractive Summarisation of Legal Judgments
description: Produces plain-language summaries of court judgments that are often tens of thousands of words long. Checks generated summaries for unsupported claims, since a fluent summary that invents a holding is actively dangerous in a legal context.

title: Clinical Note De-Identification
description: Removes patient identifiers such as names, dates and record numbers from clinical notes before research use. Tuned aggressively for recall, because a single missed identifier defeats the entire purpose of the pipeline.

title: Chatbot for Campus Admissions Queries
description: Answers prospective student questions about courses, fees and deadlines by retrieving from official documents. Cites the source document for every answer and refuses when nothing relevant is retrieved, rather than improvising policy.

title: Product Title Normalisation for Catalogues
description: Converts messy marketplace product titles into structured brand, model and attribute fields. Deduplicates listings that describe the same product with different wording, which is the precondition for any price comparison.

title: Hate Speech Detection with Context
description: Detects hate speech using the surrounding conversation rather than the message alone, since quotation and counter-speech invert intent. Audits false positive rates across dialects, where context-free models are known to over-flag.

title: Argument Stance Detection on Social Issues
description: Determines whether a text argues for, against or neutrally about a specified target claim. Stance is defined relative to the target rather than absolutely, so the same sentence flips label as the target changes.

title: Automatic Tag Suggestion for Blog Posts
description: Suggests relevant tags for a blog post from its content, treating each tag as an independent label. Tunes per-tag thresholds, since a single global cutoff either floods common tags or never predicts rare ones.

title: Query Autocomplete with Sequence Models
description: Suggests query completions as the user types, ranked by likelihood and past popularity. Serves suggestions within a strict latency budget, because a completion that arrives after the user finishes typing is worthless.

title: Spelling Correction for Noisy Search Queries
description: Corrects misspelled search queries by generating candidates within an edit distance and ranking them in context. Avoids correcting valid rare terms such as product codes, which naive dictionary correction destroys.

title: Table-to-Text Report Generation
description: Generates written summaries of tabular data such as sales reports and match statistics. Verifies every stated number against the source table, because a fluent report containing a wrong figure is worse than no report.

title: Recipe Generation from Ingredient Lists
description: Generates cooking instructions from a list of available ingredients, respecting dietary constraints. Constrains generation to the supplied ingredients, since unconstrained models cheerfully instruct the user to add things they do not have.

title: Multi-Document News Event Clustering
description: Groups news articles from multiple outlets that cover the same underlying event, then tracks the story over time. Handles the tension between splitting one story into several clusters and merging genuinely distinct events.

title: Citation Intent Classification
description: Classifies why a paper cites another as background, method use or comparison. Distinguishing supportive from contrasting citations is what turns a raw citation count into a meaningful measure of influence.

title: Voice Command Parsing for Home Automation
description: Converts spoken commands into structured device actions with slots for device, room and setting. Confirms destructive actions such as unlocking doors, rather than executing on a possibly misheard phrase.

title: Text Simplification for Accessibility
description: Rewrites complex text at a target reading level for readers with low literacy or cognitive disabilities. Measures meaning preservation alongside readability gain, because the easiest simplification is one that quietly drops information.

title: Language Learning Flashcard Generator
description: Builds vocabulary flashcards from a text a learner is reading, choosing words at the edge of their known vocabulary. Picks example sentences from the source text so new words are learned in the context the learner met them.

title: Resume Bullet Point Rewriter
description: Rewrites resume bullet points into achievement-focused phrasing with concrete metrics where present. Refuses to invent numbers that are not in the input, which is the main failure mode of generic rewriting tools.

title: Customer Complaint Severity Ranking
description: Ranks incoming complaints by severity so urgent cases reach a human first. Treats severity as ordinal rather than categorical, since confusing low with medium is far less costly than confusing low with critical.

title: Book Recommendation from Review Text
description: Recommends books by embedding what reviewers actually say about them rather than by rating overlap alone. Works for newly published titles with few ratings, which collaborative filtering cannot recommend at all.

title: Podcast Chapter Segmentation from Transcripts
description: Splits a podcast transcript into topical chapters with generated titles and timestamps. Detects boundaries from semantic drift between adjacent passages rather than fixed intervals or speaker changes.

title: Exploratory Analysis of Global Life Expectancy
description: Explores how life expectancy relates to income, schooling, immunisation and health spending across countries and decades. Demonstrates why correlations computed across countries mislead when applied to change within a single country.

title: Road Accident Hotspot Analysis
description: Identifies road segments and junctions with disproportionate accident rates, adjusted for traffic volume. Normalising by exposure is what separates genuinely dangerous junctions from merely busy ones.

title: Crime Pattern Analysis and Mapping
description: Maps reported crime by type, time and location to surface temporal and spatial patterns for resource planning. Explicitly discusses reporting bias, since crime maps show where crime is reported rather than where it occurs.

title: Airline Route Profitability Analysis
description: Analyses which airline routes generate profit once load factor, fuel, crew and airport costs are attributed. Shows how routes that look unprofitable alone are justified by the connecting traffic they feed.

title: Supermarket Sales Dashboard with Drill-Down
description: Builds an interactive dashboard for supermarket sales that drills from national totals down to a single product in a single store. Designed so each level answers one question, rather than presenting twenty charts at once.

title: Employee Salary Equity Analysis
description: Analyses pay differences across gender and ethnicity while controlling for role, seniority and tenure. Reports both the raw gap and the adjusted gap, because the difference between them is itself the finding.

title: Student Performance Factor Analysis
description: Investigates which factors most relate to student exam performance, from study hours to attendance and support. Tests whether apparent effects survive controlling for prior attainment, which most of them do not.

title: Housing Affordability Index Construction
description: Constructs a housing affordability index from price, income, interest rate and rental data across regions. Runs sensitivity analysis on the weighting, since an index whose ranking flips under small weight changes should not be published.

title: Public Transport Punctuality Analysis
description: Analyses delay patterns across bus and rail services by route, hour and weather condition. Uses percentile delay rather than mean, because averages hide the tail that actually makes passengers miss connections.

title: Electricity Tariff Comparison Tool
description: Compares electricity tariffs against a household's actual consumption profile to find the cheapest plan. Models time-of-use tariffs properly, where the best plan depends on when power is used rather than how much.

title: Agricultural Yield Gap Analysis
description: Quantifies the gap between actual and achievable crop yields by region and identifies the factors most associated with it. Separates gaps explained by climate from those explained by practice, since only the second is addressable.

title: Hospital Readmission Rate Analysis
description: Analyses thirty-day readmission rates across hospitals with risk adjustment for patient case mix. Unadjusted comparison penalises hospitals that treat sicker patients, which is why raw league tables mislead.

title: Vaccination Coverage Disparity Analysis
description: Analyses vaccination coverage across districts and demographic groups to locate under-served populations. Reports absolute and relative disparity, which can point in opposite directions and support different interventions.

title: Air Pollution Trend Analysis by City
description: Analyses multi-year air quality data across cities, separating seasonal cycles from underlying trend. Shows how a city can improve year on year while still breaching daily limits every winter.

title: Water Consumption Pattern Analysis
description: Analyses household water consumption patterns to identify leaks, seasonal variation and unusually high users. A sustained overnight baseline is the clearest leak signal and requires no model at all.

title: E-Commerce Funnel Drop-Off Analysis
description: Analyses where users abandon the path from product view to completed purchase, segmented by device and traffic source. Distinguishes steps with high drop-off from steps with high drop-off cost, which rank very differently.

title: A/B Test Analysis Framework
description: Provides a reusable framework for analysing A/B tests including power calculation, significance testing and effect size. Refuses to report a result before the planned sample size is reached, which is the most common way real experiments go wrong.

title: Cohort Retention Analysis for Subscriptions
description: Analyses how long subscribers stay, grouped by the month they joined, to reveal whether retention is improving. Cohort curves separate genuine product improvement from growth that merely masks a constant churn rate.

title: RFM Segmentation for Customer Marketing
description: Segments customers by recency, frequency and monetary value into actionable marketing groups. Maps each segment to a specific action, since a segmentation nobody acts on is just a colourful scatter plot.

title: Sentiment Trend Dashboard for Brand Monitoring
description: Tracks public sentiment about a brand over time and alerts on sudden negative shifts. Separates volume spikes from sentiment shifts, because a surge of positive mentions and a crisis look identical on a raw mention count.

title: Sports League Performance Analytics
description: Analyses team and player performance across a league season with strength-adjusted metrics. Adjusting for opposition quality is what prevents a strong record against weak opponents from looking like dominance.

title: Movie Ratings Bias Analysis
description: Investigates systematic biases in film ratings across genre, release era and reviewer demographics. Examines selection bias in who chooses to rate at all, which usually dominates any rating-scale effect.

title: Startup Funding Trend Analysis
description: Analyses startup funding rounds by sector, stage and geography to surface where capital is concentrating. Handles the heavy right skew of funding amounts, where a handful of mega-rounds distort every average.

title: Cryptocurrency Volatility Analysis
description: Analyses and models volatility clustering in cryptocurrency prices using rolling and conditional volatility measures. Demonstrates why volatility is far more predictable than price direction, and what that does and does not enable.

title: Supply Chain Delay Root Cause Analysis
description: Analyses shipment delays across suppliers, routes and modes to identify which stages contribute most. Decomposes end-to-end delay by stage, since the longest stage and the most variable stage are rarely the same one.

title: Call Centre Volume and Staffing Analysis
description: Forecasts call volume by half-hour and converts it into staffing requirements using queueing formulas. Shows why staffing to average volume produces long waits during predictable peaks.

title: Insurance Claims Cost Driver Analysis
description: Analyses which policy, claimant and incident factors drive insurance claim severity. Models frequency and severity separately, since the factors that make a claim likely differ from those that make it expensive.

title: Retail Price Elasticity Estimation
description: Estimates how demand responds to price changes per product category from historical sales and promotions. Addresses the endogeneity problem where prices are cut precisely when demand is already falling, which biases naive estimates.

title: Churn Reason Analysis from Exit Surveys
description: Analyses free-text exit survey responses to quantify why customers actually leave. Cross-tabulates stated reasons against behavioural data, because what people say and what they did frequently disagree.

title: Weather Impact on Retail Footfall
description: Quantifies how temperature and rainfall affect store visits, controlling for day of week and season. Separating weather from seasonality is essential, since both move together across the year.

title: Census Data Demographic Explorer
